review_type: fresh independent CPU code quality review

findings.problem: Formal validity can pass without the frozen archive and with an incorrect manifest tree digest.
reproduction: Read source_manifest()[files] and add the repository-relative required harness SHA256.
Write a temporary JSON with these files and tree_sha256=incorrect-tree-digest, without creating any archive.
findings.required_fix: Validate canonical manifest digest and a content-bound immutable archive at start and end. Matching loose files alone cannot certify an archive.

resolution.change: Real archive is mandatory. Canonical tree, internal unbound manifest, complete regular-file member map and every archived file hash are independently verified. Optional private binding additionally pins archive/internal-manifest digests.
resolution.independent_actual_control: Original loose wrongdigest/noarchive rejected; genuine47file source archive passed both harnesses and extracted-runtime execution. Legacy internal manifest passed only with explicit genuine archive; archive SHA unchanged.

findings.problem: Required harness is checked relative to cwd; the executing __file__ bytes need not equal that frozen file.
reproduction: Create a genuine source archive using freeze() with current runtime files and the required ablation harness.
Copy the harness to a temporary external_harness.py and append a comment.
Import the external module and call its freeze_record(genuine_manifest) from the repository cwd.
findings.required_fix: Compare executing harness SHA256 from __file__ to the declared manifest entry, at start and end; apply the same binding to the development probe.

resolution.change: Both ablation and probe pass executing __file__ to the freeze verifier; the executed digest must equal the declared archived member. Final frozen_execution_valid binds initial/end manifest/archive/internal-manifest/source/harness digests.
resolution.independent_actual_control: Modified external harness imported from temporary path rejected against genuine archive; actual frozen harness with frozen runtime accepted.

findings.problem: A nonpositive repeat count is accepted; empty held-out coverage passes all(empty).
reproduction: Extract the exact equivalent_speedup_claim_supported expression from the current harness AST.
Evaluate with args.smoke=False, report.freeze.formal_validity=True and heldout=[].
The parser currently accepts --repeats=0; no fake benchmark or GPU execution was used for this logic repro.

observed.method: exact source AST expression evaluated on CPU

findings.required_fix: Reject nonpositive repeats/max_tokens and require the complete nonempty predeclared held-out prompt/repeat coverage for an accepted performance-validity flag.

resolution.change: Positive counts validated before importing MLX. Final acceptance requires complete nonempty predeclared prompt/repeat/variant coverage, no errors, nonempty retained token IDs, finite positive measured time and direct token equality rather than stale equality flags.

findings.problem: correctness_and_maturity_pass is computed without source_unchanged, initial/end freeze validity, or executing harness provenance.
reproduction: Inspect summary construction followed by source_end/source_unchanged/freeze_end.
Those later results do not revise any accepted probe pass flag.
findings.required_fix: Keep separate raw functionality/oracle outcomes and introduce or gate an accepted frozen-probe pass using valid initial/end archive+executing-harness checks and unchanged source/harness.

resolution.change: Raw functionality/oracle outcomes are retained. accepted_frozen_probe_pass is computed only after end checks and requires unchanged genuine frozen execution; fatal error always rejects accepted probe.

sound_controls: Default public hybrid registry remains baseline-only and refuses speculative requests before enqueue.
Explicit experimental service metadata is a deep local copy; flags separately reach the default engine factory and benchmark wrapper.
Greedy-only speculative sampling constraints remain enforced.
Hybrid lagged adapter is scoped to hybrid adaptive requests; baseline/fixed/native and nonhybrid DS stay usable, with requested/applicable/effective metrics.
Performance wrapper defaults diagnostics off; profiling probe explicitly enables them.
Independent policy objects, development-only fixed tuning and full held-out outputs/errors are retained.
Independent C++ header SHA is checked; min5/window9 defaults and N-2/full-cycle/partial feedback remain explicit.
Immature trace does not pass the oracle.
limits: No GPU inference, Metal API/SSE, real-model min5/window9 maturity, or speed benchmark was executed by this review.
Stateful fake-device traces and CPU provenance products are correctness controls, not model performance data.
These CPU changes are approved for fresh frozen hardware validation; this does not certify speedup, quality superiority, or completed joint release goal.
